id: \rMay: Good to see you \PN. Looks like you got my message.
en: \rMay: Good to see you \PN. Looks like you got my message.
it: \rVera: Che bello vederti, \PN. A quanto pare hai ricevuto il mio messaggio.

id: \rYou got all the badges you needed too. Good for you. I just got my last ribbon.
en: \rYou got all the badges you needed too. Good for you. I just got my last ribbon.
it: \rHai anche ottenuto tutte le medaglie che ti servivano. Ottimo lavoro! Io ho appena vinto il mio ultimo fiocco.

id: \rTime for us to test how strong we are now.
en: \rTime for us to test how strong we are now.
it: \rÈ ora di vedere quanto siamo diventati forti.

id: \rMay: Aw man, I thought I was going to win. Oh well. Good luck at the league.
en: \rMay: Aw man, I thought I was going to win. Oh well. Good luck at the league.
it: \rVera: Uffa, pensavo di vincere io. Pazienza. Buona fortuna alla Lega.

id: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, After You.
en: \bAfter spending years in this town I decided to help out and teach the move, After You.
it: \bDopo aver passato anni in questa città ho deciso di rendermi utile insegnando la mossa Cortesia.

id: \bI can teach it to you if you want?
en: \bI can teach it to you if you want?

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
en: \rI'm very sorry, but you missed the deadline to compete.
it: \rMi dispiace molto, ma il termine per le iscrizioni è scaduto.

id: \bI lost, but boy, what a performance.
en: \bI lost, but boy, what a performance.

id: \rI lost in the second round. I got so nervous I forgot what to do.
en: \rI lost in the second round. I got so nervous I forgot what to do.
it: \rSono stata eliminata al secondo turno. Ero così nervosa che ho dimenticato cosa fare.
